answer_1.quote: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) is one of the most studied Natural Language Processing (NLP) tasks.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated translations using lexical (BLEU , ChrF , ME-TEOR ) and modelbased metrics (BERTScore , BLEURT , XCOMET , GEMBA-MQM ).

answer_3.quote: Our SWILTRA-JUDGE: An LLM-based method aligned with human expert annotations, offering a reliable automated framework to assess translation quality.

answer_4.quote: To study how well human legal experts agree with the automated metrics, we conducted an expert evaluation. All experts are authors of the paper; the majority are doctoral candidates, and all hold at least a Bachelor's degree in Swiss law.
answer_4.guideline: The experts were asked to assign a score between 0 and 100 to each translation... The scores only reflected the completeness and accuracy of the predicted translation, with less emphasis on readability and other stylistic attributes.
